_comment: 카드 id → 이미지 생성용 영어 장면 묘사. tools/image-prompts.mjs 가 읽는다. 없는 카드는 desc 로 대체. 글자가 그려지지 않도록 문서·간판·숫자 묘사는 피하고 시각 요소로만 쓴다.
plan-01: A writer at a cafe table buried under a tower of script drafts, each stack taller and messier than the last, the producer peeking over the pile in horror while the writer proudly slaps another stack on top
plan-02: A producer squinting through a magnifying glass at a thick stack of papers covered in meaningless squiggles, one squiggle glowing ominously red, while in a thought bubble a webtoon artist sleeps face-down on a drawing tablet with a snoring bubble
plan-03: A tiny meeting room where a college student in a hoodie proudly points at a whiteboard covered in giant doodled exclamation marks and stars, a beaming executive uncle applauds, the director facepalms
plan-04: A small film crew peering over a fence at a gigantic neighboring film set with cranes, lights and a towering blank billboard, their own set behind them is a single cardboard box and one lamp
plan-05: A producer frantically repainting a city skyline backdrop into a seaside harbor town while a cheerful regional official holding a giant oversized blank check waits with a stopwatch
plan-06: A pitch stage where a nervous producer presents to a judging panel, the middle judge fast asleep with a drool bubble, another judge scrolling a phone, one judge politely awake
plan-07: A slick older producer in sunglasses whispering to a young producer at a bar counter, holding out one open palm for cash while the other hand gestures at an imaginary rich investor made of sparkles
plan-08: A director holding a script scroll that unrolls across the whole room and out the door, a producer at the far end holding up a tiny pair of scissors with a pleading face, a wall clock sweating
plan-09: A producer answering a phone in a quiet office, face going pale, while a very calm elderly woman on the other end of the call appears in a thought bubble holding an old framed photograph
plan-10: Two assistant director candidates side by side: a veteran with a color-coded clipboard and stopwatch, and a wide-eyed film student with a tote bag and a laptop covered in stickers, the producer in the middle sweating
plan-11: A producer surrounded by seven open cardboard boxes overflowing with old script pages, reading one with sparkly eyes at 3am, coffee cups everywhere, one golden page glowing
plan-12: A professor in a tweed jacket lecturing with a pointer at a chalkboard full of meaningless diagrams and arrows in a tiny production office, twelve students taking notes, the producer squeezed against the wall
fund-01: A producer standing at an empty desk in an investment firm, a nameplate holder on the desk now empty, the new young manager tilting their head with a big question mark, a pitch deck gathering dust
fund-02: An investor sliding a stack of papers across a table with one hand while the other presents a glossy headshot of a nervous new actor, the producer and director exchanging a look
fund-03: A very young investor in a hoodie and gold chain pouring a waterfall of shiny gold coins out of a laptop onto a meeting table, the producer catching them in a popcorn bucket
fund-04: A film set where every character holds the same blue water bottle, including a mourner at a funeral scene and a ghost, a cheerful brand manager giving two thumbs up from behind the camera
fund-05: A sales agent in a tropical shirt at an airport pointing at a big empty silhouette on a movie poster where a famous actor should be, the producer holding a cardboard cutout with a question mark face
fund-06: A director at dawn surrounded by torn-up pages triumphantly holding up a brand new treatment, the producer in pajamas staring at a wall calendar where tomorrow is circled in thick red marker
fund-07: A crowdfunding progress bar on a laptop overflowing past its end with confetti, three dentists in white coats posing dramatically as detectives in the background, the director sighing
fund-08: A bored executive stamping a huge shiny golden seal onto a movie poster without looking, while a big slice is cut out of a pie-shaped cake decorated like a film reel and carried away
fund-09: A producer waiting outside an apartment door at night with a thermos, a phone in hand showing a red line chart plunging off the bottom of the screen, a pizza delivery passing by
fund-10: A serial killer thriller scene awkwardly set in a sunny town festival with balloons and a vegetable mascot, a proud mayor with a sash pointing at a blank banner, the director hiding behind the camera
fund-11: A producer in an empty office holding a landline phone with a cut cord, a wall calendar with one day circled in red, the director pushing a cart with a house-shaped piggy bank
fund-12: A producer holding a phone with sparkles coming out of it, a cheerful accountant in a thought bubble holding a fat envelope bursting with bills, crew members peeking in from the door with hopeful eyes
fund-13: A wealthy chairman at a dinner table raising a glass with a warm smile, a giant bag of money on the table, and behind him a shadow holding a thick book with his own face on the cover and a young man in a costume
cast-01: A top star arriving at a tiny office with an entourage of three stylists, a rolling rack of clothes, and a scroll of squiggly demands unrolling down the stairs, the director hiding behind a plant
cast-02: A producer holding a pen one millimeter above the signature line of a blank page while a phone next to it lights up with an angry red forum post made of squiggles, everyone in the room frozen mid-breath
cast-03: A director hugging a sheepish actor friend while the producer holds up a tiny receipt with a very short squiggle, an investor in the background squinting
cast-04: A K-pop idol in a sparkly stage outfit standing in a script reading room surrounded by serious actors, a wall of fan light sticks glowing through the window, the director sighing
cast-05: A veteran character actor pushing away a pay envelope and instead holding up a slice of a pie chart with a greedy-yet-honest smile, the producer calculating on fingers
cast-06: An audition room where a young woman performs earnestly while her father, a CEO in a suit, casually sits in the corner holding a newspaper upside down and peeking over it
cast-07: A child actor performing beautifully on set while a mother in a visor sits right beside the director's monitor, pointing at the screen and giving notes, the director leaning away
cast-08: A fax machine spitting out an endlessly long paper covered in squiggles and red stamps, the producer flipping through headshots desperately, a wall calendar with two weeks crossed off
cast-09: A lead actor flexing in a harness in front of a wall of dangerous stunt props, the stunt coordinator and an insurance agent clutching each other in fear
cast-10: A storm of angry phone icons and hashtag-shaped clouds swirling around a movie poster, two sponsor mascots quietly tiptoeing away, the producer holding an umbrella
cast-11: An agent across a desk sliding a card showing a crossed-out director's chair icon, while through a thin wall the current director is visibly listening with a glass pressed to the wall
cast-12: An audition room at the end of the day, the last performer with a number tag reading a line, the director's pen dropping in slow motion, the casting assistant's jaw dropped
cast-13: A top star's agent presenting a contract with a giant red half-price tag shape on the front page, while the back page unfolds into a very long sheet of tiny squiggles behind their back
shoot-01: A film crew on day one standing under umbrellas in pouring rain, a phone screen showing a smiling sun weather icon, the location owner tapping a watch
shoot-02: Village elders with blank protest banners and a megaphone protesting at a rice paddy while a film crew bows apologetically, one grandma already eyeing the craft service table
shoot-03: A lead actor sitting on a staircase holding a swollen ankle with a tiny pain spark, the producer holding a schedule board where most of the squares are highlighted in red
shoot-04: A director and a cinematographer in a dramatic standoff on a film set over a huge professional studio film light on a tall C-stand with barn doors and a diffusion frame, one pulling the barn doors shut and the other yanking them open, cables everywhere, sixty crew members silently looking at their phones
shoot-05: A drone splashing into the sea with a tiny memory card flying out, a drone operator reaching out dramatically from a cliff, a seagull watching
shoot-06: A huge empty plaza with a tiny cluster of fifty extras spread far apart, the assistant director counting on fingers with a horrified face next to an empty bus
shoot-07: A blurry phone photo of an actor smoking behind a set inside a forum thread full of squiggly comments, the real actor peeking at the phone over someone's shoulder in horror
shoot-08: A producer at a tiny desk shaking an empty wallet with a moth flying out, a wall calendar with one day circled, the lighting chief standing in the doorway with folded arms and a very patient face
shoot-09: A split scene: an idol performing on a glowing concert stage on the left, and on the right the same idol in costume filming at night under a moon with dark circles under the eyes
shoot-10: A passport slammed with a big red X stamp, next to it a Paris street poster being swapped for a Korean street, an art director covering a signboard with a cloth
shoot-11: A director calling for one more take with a tower of forty-seven tally-mark chalk lines on a slate behind, an actress on the ground having cried, laughed and cried again, the sun setting rapidly
shoot-12: A regional film council auditor with a clipboard measuring a pie chart on a wall with a tape measure, the producer nervously pointing at a harbor painted on a studio wall
shoot-13: An actor on a very high wire above the set looking down with a frozen smile, the stunt coordinator below covering their eyes, a crash mat the size of a napkin
shoot-14: A famous YouTuber with a selfie stick filming a vlog in the middle of a serious film set, the director in frame wearing headphones looking confused, a floating subscriber-count bell icon
shoot-15: A whole film crew sprinting out of a building carrying camera, lights and cables toward an absurdly beautiful orange sunset, the cinematographer leading like a general
shoot-16: A free abandoned factory set that looks perfect, the crew cheering, while a tiny inspector in a hazmat suit pokes the wall and a cloud of dust puffs out
post-01: An editing room where a timeline on the monitor stretches off the screen and across the wall, the director hugging the timeline, the editor sharpening a giant pair of scissors
post-02: A VFX studio door locked with chains and a padlock, dozens of unfinished explosion shots floating as sad gray boxes, the producer knocking with a hard drive in hand
post-03: A music director conducting an imaginary sixty-piece orchestra in a tiny mixing room, a postcard of a European old town pinned to the wall, the accountant fainting behind a calculator
post-04: A rating board official slamming a huge red circular stamp onto a film reel, the producer holding a budget sheet that bursts into flames, the director weirdly proud
post-05: A test screening audience filling out survey cards, one card held up showing a huge sad face drawing, a pie chart on the wall that is almost entirely gray
post-06: A courtroom where a producer in a suit faces a calm family and their lawyer, a gavel mid-air, the director doodling in the gallery
post-07: A colorist in a dark grading suite pointing at a completely gray image on a big monitor, the cinematographer insisting it is intentional, both holding cigarettes they are about to go smoke
post-08: A director discovering a hidden hard drive wrapped in red tape in an editing suite, the producer frozen in the doorway holding two coffees, the editor pretending to be asleep
post-09: A festival programmer in a scarf watching a rough cut with glowing eyes, a plane ticket and a red carpet rolling out of the laptop, a wall calendar being flipped forward
post-10: A lead actor in a recording booth wrapped in a blanket with a red nose, a sound wave on the monitor dipping low, a voice actor waiting outside with a thermos
post-11: A post-production vendor hugging a hard drive tightly with a sly smile, the producer on both knees, a bank brochure peeking out of a pocket
post-12: An editor shyly showing a secret alternative ending on a monitor at dawn, the director staring in silence with a lump in the throat, the producer quietly fist-pumping
post-13: A startup founder in a hoodie demonstrating an app that makes a robot mouth speak over the actor's face on a laptop, the sound engineer backing away slowly
mkt-01: A tiny movie poster squeezed between two enormous blockbuster posters in a cinema lobby, the distributor shrugging on the phone, a calendar with one date circled three times
mkt-02: Two trailer storyboards side by side: a somber dramatic one and a slapstick one with laughing faces, the marketing team pointing at the slapstick one, the director covering the film reel
mkt-03: A producer at a Korean BBQ dinner bowing deeply to a union leader with a sash, a special poster on the wall with a raised fist awkwardly pasted onto a thriller design
mkt-04: A slick marketing agent whispering behind a hand, rows of identical empty theater seats glowing behind them connected by red strings like a conspiracy board
mkt-05: A director in a radio studio with headphones blurting into the mic with a speech bubble full of lightning bolts, while across the city the investor CEO drops a coffee cup listening in a car
mkt-06: A famous critic typing on a phone, a single tiny star and a half floating above a cinema as a small raincloud, the crew looking up with umbrellas
mkt-07: A top star's manager pointing at a page with a ruler, the producer counting stage greeting events on fingers, the star filing nails in the background
mkt-08: Two movie posters side by side on a wall that look suspiciously identical, a crowd comparing them with magnifying glasses, the poster designer whistling innocently
mkt-09: A streaming platform executive handing over a giant oversized check in exchange for a film reel, the director clutching a cinema seat, the investor smiling for the first time
mkt-10: A lead actor from a crime thriller dancing stiffly to a theme song in front of a phone on a tripod, the marketing team cheering, the dance has zero rhythm
mkt-11: A TV ad schedule board with every slot covered by red circular stamps, the marketing team pivoting to a wall of video thumbnails, the budget jar nearly empty
mkt-12: A legendary director's phone post with a tiny speech bubble causing a flood of follower icons to pour into a small account like a dam breaking, the crew riding the wave
mkt-13: A viral marketing salesperson presenting an eleven-page contract with a shiny gold sticker, the tiny squiggly fine print visibly crawling like ants
rel-01: A producer at a cinema on opening morning staring at a showtime board where their film's poster appears in only two tiny slots at the very top and very bottom, the distributor on the phone shrugging
rel-02: Opening day newspaper with a front page photo of two silhouettes holding hands, each pointing at a different movie poster, fans holding both tickets confused
rel-03: A newspaper front page with a seat-map chart full of identical red dots, the marketing agency boss on a beach far away with a cocktail, the producer sinking into a chair
rel-04: An empty director's chair at a stage greeting with a question mark floating above, cast members awkwardly waving, the director far away in a small bubble sweating in a sauna
rel-05: A completely empty cinema auditorium on a Saturday night while through the wall the whole nation watches a soccer final on a giant screen, one lonely usher with popcorn
rel-06: Forty tour buses full of union members arriving at the wrong cinema whose marquee shows a different poster, a tiny staffer holding a dusty old schedule
rel-07: A Q&A session where the entire audience raises hands with question marks over their heads, the director holding the mic in frozen silence, a single sweat drop
rel-08: A single viewer in a huge empty morning screening typing a passionately long review on a phone, the screen glowing, an eye icon with a very small counter
rel-09: A small theater where every seat is packed and people sit on the stairs, a distributor rushing in with a phone, a bar chart on a tablet with one bar towering over the rest
rel-10: A streaming platform server room with smoke coming out and engineers panicking, a tiny film thumbnail waiting patiently inside a loading spinner
rel-11: Two posters with the same premise side by side, one glossy with a trophy-holding star, one modest, a news crowd rushing past the modest one toward the glossy one
rel-12: A rival blockbuster's projector sparking and shutting down while in the next auditorium a small film's crew nervously welcomes a flood of redirected viewers
rel-13: A suspiciously friendly cinema chain manager offering a fan of twenty golden tickets with a giant smile, a small invoice shape peeking out from behind his back
